name: Pixelcut
tagline: Pixelcut is an AI-powered photo editor built specifically for e-commerce product photography. It removes backgrounds, generates AI product backgrounds, upscales images, and batch-edits product photos to create consistent, professional listings for Shopify, Etsy, and Amazon. Its mobile app makes studio-quality photos possible from a smartphone.
